slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single copy at SRAM offset 0. FUN_08000584 reads it via FUN_08015b68(0x0E000000,RAM,length); validity decided solely by u32 at offset 0 vs a literal-pool constant. On mismatch RAM-side defaults are initialised (68x u16 OR-loop at RAM+0x4780 and RAM+DAT_08000674). No backup/mirror copy, generation counter or slot-selection comparison was found in the 57-function corpus; bytes 0x4780-0x7FFF in cap-01 are 0xFF (untouched) except an unexplained 12-byte zero island at 0x4890. Size 18304 (0x4780) is inferred from the exact cap-00->cap-01 diff boundary 0x0000-0x477F, corroborated by the RAM+0x4780 reference in both seed functions; the literal copy-length (_DAT_08000580/_DAT_08000660) is unresolved in the decompilation.

checksums.name: none_found
checksums.formula_detail: No checksum/integrity computation over the save buffer exists in the traced corpus: no arithmetic loop over the payload appears in any of the 57 decompiled functions (the only arithmetic loops are the M4A audio cluster 0x08014xxx-0x08015670 and the integer divider FUN_08015d14). Python tests on cap-01 over 0x04..0x4780 (all zero) give sum8/sum16/sum32=0, xor8/xor32=0, crc32=0x8d7fbee4, adler32=0x477c0001, crc16-modbus=0xc154, crc16-ccitt=0x6d25; none equals the stored dword0 0x6e512be4 (LE), consistent with dword0 being a constant magic rather than a computed checksum. A custom checksum cannot be excluded but has no supporting code evidence.

io_driver_functions.notes: Save writer (MMIO seed). Stamps dword0 and other fields into RAM struct (base=_DAT_08000534, unresolved), calls FUN_08014d90, byte-writes RAM->0x0E000000 via FUN_08015bcc(base,0x0E000000,_DAT_08000580), verifies via FUN_08015c3c(base,0x0E000000,length), calls FUN_08014ddc, tail-dispatches on verify result through UNRECOVERED_JUMPTABLE. No caller in callgraph.json or decompiled.c.

Save reader (MMIO seed). FUN_08015b68(0x0E000000,RAM_base=_DAT_0800065c,_DAT_08000660); if *RAM_base != _DAT_08000664, initialises defaults: 68-iteration (0x43 down to 0) u16 OR-loop at RAM+0x4780 and RAM+_DAT_08000674 with value _DAT_08000670. Then copies struct fields out to globals and tail-dispatches. No caller in corpus.

Low-level SRAM byte-copy (SDK WriteSram-style): sets a WAITCNT-like register (*_DAT_08015c04 & mask | 3, cf. 0x04000204 SRAM wait bits) then while(count-- != -1) *dst++ = *src++ byte loop, required by the 8-bit SRAM bus at 0x0E000000. Called in decompiled.c as func_0x08015bcc; absent from callgraph.json edges.

Low-level SRAM read (SDK ReadSram-style): sets WAITCNT-like register |3, copies via stack buffer and calls FUN_08015ce4(src,dst,len,stack+1). Direction proven by call site FUN_08015b68(0x0E000000,RAM,len) in FUN_08000584.

Verify-after-write (SDK VerifySram-style): same WAITCNT/stack-buffer prologue as FUN_08015b68, calls FUN_08015ce4(RAM,0x0E000000,len,stack+1) and returns its result; FUN_08000484 tail-dispatches on the returned value. Exact compare semantics inside FUN_08015ce4 are not recovered (jump-table stub).
Unrecovered jump-table stub invoked with (src,dst,len,stack_buf) by both SRAM read and verify routines; internal copy/compare not recoverable from this corpus.

Pre-write helper also called by FUN_08014ca4 (audio cluster): conditionally advances a counter by 10 and clears fields via FUN_08015b38 (SWI 0x0B CpuSet wrapper). Save-specific role unproven; likely a shared sound/system guard, NOT proven save logic.
Post-write helper also called by FUN_08014c00 (audio): conditionally writes 0xB600 and decrements a counter by 10. Save-specific role unproven; shared with the M4A audio cluster.
software_interrupt(0x0B) = BIOS CpuSet wrapper. Used by audio/init code, not a save driver.

fields.name: magic_dword0
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_08000484 executes *RAM_base = _DAT_0800057c (literal-pool constant) immediately before FUN_08015bcc flushes RAM to 0x0E000000; FUN_08000584 compares *RAM_base against _DAT_08000664 after FUN_08015b68 loads SRAM, branching to default-initialisation on mismatch. RAM base literal (_DAT_08000534/_DAT_0800065c) is unresolved, so ram_addr is null.
fields.evidence: ghidra/decompiled.c:36 (*puVar1 = _DAT_0800057c) and :72 (if *piVar1 != _DAT_08000664); sav dword0 is the ONLY non-zero dword in cap-01. Equality of the two unresolved constants with each other / with 0x6E512BE4 is inferred, not directly read, hence not CONFIRMED_VERIFIED.

open_questions: Exact numeric values of ALL _DAT_ literal-pool operands in FUN_08000484/FUN_08000584 (RAM struct base address, copy length _DAT_08000580/_DAT_08000660, magic constants _DAT_0800057c/_DAT_08000664, OR-default value _DAT_08000670, second default-array offset _DAT_08000674) are unresolved in ghidra/decompiled.c; the 0x4780 length and 0x6E512BE4 magic are therefore inferred from .sav geometry + code structure, not read from code.

Internal layout of payload 0x0004-0x477F is completely unmapped: the only populated sample is all zero there, so no sub-field offset, type or semantics can be assigned without a non-trivial gameplay save.
Who calls FUN_08000484 / FUN_08000584, and in what menu/boot state? Both have zero callers in callgraph.json and decompiled.c and exit via UNRECOVERED_JUMPTABLE; trigger context is unknown.

Is there a checksum at all? None found in the 57-function corpus and no standard algorithm matches dword0, but the corpus is trace-guided and partial; a checksum routine outside the traced set cannot be excluded.
What wrote the 12 zero bytes at 0x4890-0x489B in cap-01, inside otherwise untouched 0xFF SRAM? No traced function accounts for it.
Are FUN_08014d90/FUN_08014ddc (shared with the 0x08014xxx M4A audio cluster) genuinely part of the save path (e.g. sound quiesce before SRAM access) or Ghidra/trace artefacts of the seed extraction?
Is the RAM flag array at RAM+0x4780 persisted (copy length > 0x4780) or RAM-only re-derived state? The cap-01 0xFF bytes at file 0x4780 favour RAM-only / length==0x4780 but do not prove it.
